maya: quick sync — we're looking at onboarding 6 large LLM variants this quarter, but infra quota for dedicated pools is tight. thinking: staggered onboards + pin windows. need ops + eng tradeoffs.
sam: what are the size profiles? seq len / kv cache behavior?
maya: roughly: 2x 8B opt-like (short conv), 2x 30B decoder-only (long), 2x open-instruction (heavy embeddings). estimated p50 tokens: 256, 1024, 128 respectively.
nina: ops POV — capacity hits from long seq models. autoscale cold-starts cost spike. recommend: canary with reduced max_seq and a KV-prefix cache shimming.
julio: +1. can we require a benchmark run: 50k inference tokens, tail lat / p95, cost-per-1k? need that to approve pin.
tara: propose launch gates: (1) bench: p95 within SLA, (2) cost delta <1.8x baseline, (3) compatibility: same API + migration doc. Any objections?
maya: sounds reasonable. customers asked for pin for 30 days after launch. can we do 14-day pin + opt-in extension?
sam: engineering prefers 7-day pin for fast rollbacks. 14 seems ok if we have automatic fallback to a smaller variant.
nina: fallback route ok but we need a circuit-breaker: if p95 > SLA for >10m across >5% infra, auto-route.
ops-bot: [AUTO] Created rollback policy: rollback_threshold=1.5x_cost | latency_threshold=1.3x_p95 | window=600s :gear:
julio: capture two exceptions: enterprise contracts may need longer pin, and non-backwards compatible tokenizer changes — need migration shim.
tara: decision: adopt gates, bench spec from Julio, runtime circuit-breaker from Nina, pin = 14d default, exceptions via legal+sales.
maya: I'll raise a short PR with benchmark script + template checklist. can folks review by EOD Friday? :calendar:
sam: will review.
nina: will validate autoscale thresholds.
julio: aim to merge test harness by Friday morning.
maya: thanks team. logging followups in GH issue rwd/cat-onboard-3287. :thumbsup:
